يعتصرن (form VIII)
# يَعْتَصِرْنَ (yaʕtaṣirna) /jaʕ.ta.sˤir.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
# يُعْتَصَرْنَ (yuʕtaṣarna) /juʕ.ta.sˤar.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
